preview.off: Turn Flurry on to see it here
plow.desc.on: Clears deep snow off the bottom of the screen
plow.desc.off: Off: the plow never comes, not even when called
snowballs.desc: Scoop, roll and throw the snow lying on screen
visitors.desc: Santa rides by; the Yeti comes for your snowman
surprises.desc: A robin, a winter hare and the golden snowflake
flag.liveWeather.desc: Snow, wind and temperature from Open-Meteo
flag.dayCycle.desc: Thaw by day, icicles, frost and night glaze
flag.windGusts.desc: Fling a window and it blows the snow about
flag.seasons.desc: Snow thaws, sprouts come up and petals fall
flag.newYear.desc: A countdown and fireworks at midnight on January 1
flag.writing.desc: Hold Ctrl and drag across the snow
flag.themeSync.desc: Lights, scarves and shadows follow your Omarchy theme
flag.throwToFriends.desc: A snowball flung off the screen lands on a friend's desktop
battery.desc: Half the effect and 30 fps when unplugged
baubles.tip: Bauble finish for new baubles (golden snowflakes unlock more)
friends.intro: Swap codes with friends to send them snowmen, trees and notes on the little train.
friends.howto: Copy your code and send it to a friend, then add theirs. Right-click a snowman or tree to send it.
why.onlySnow: the hare comes only in snow
why.noGroundSnow: no snow on the ground yet
sound.desc: Rain, thunder with the lightning, rustling leaves, crickets...
service.unavailable: Flurry's bar widget requires the built-in Omarchy bar.
